description: UX/product designer role with Figma and design system requirements

input.jobDescription:
Senior UX Designer at DesignLab

DesignLab creates enterprise design tools used by 200,000 designers worldwide. We need a Senior UX Designer to evolve our product design language.

What you'll do:
- Lead UX research: user interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry
- Design end-to-end user flows and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma
- Evolve and maintain our Figma-based design system (500+ components)
- Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance
- Facilitate design sprints and collaborative workshops in Miro
- Work closely with product managers and engineers

Required:
- 5+ years UX design experience, 2+ on enterprise SaaS products
- Expert Figma skills including component variants, auto layout, and prototyping
- Experience building or maintaining design systems
- User research methods: interviews, usability testing, surveys
- Strong understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG)

Desired:
- Experience with motion design and Lottie animations
- Familiarity with front-end development (HTML/CSS) to collaborate better with engineers

Portfolio required. Apply at designlab.com/careers
